en: A black‑and‑white view of a riverside promenade with several multi‑storey 19th‑century buildings. In the foreground is an ornate wrought‑iron bridge railing and a shallow riverbed. Along the opposite bank stand grand hotels and cafes with awnings and shutters; horse‑drawn carriages wait in front. The most prominent building bears the sign "Hôtel Paradies" with "Café & Restaurant" at street level, and another sign reading "Paradies Hôtel". The scene suggests a spa or resort town in central Europe in the late 19th or early 20th century.
